answer: Tie each key to an open-source track record: it must sign at least 5 commits merged in the last 180 days into third-party repos with 50+ stars, each merged by a different maintainer outside the key's funding cluster. An honest coder already has this; each fake needs ~15 hours of real reviewed work, so 100 sybils cost ~1,500 dev-hours and a 180-day horizon. Typo-fix farms stay hollow: diffs under 20 lines don't count, and keys merged by the same maintainers collapse to one seat. Pay sits in a vault until re-checked.
